# NX-OS LLDP Integration Test


-- state/preload --
{
  "System": {
    "name": "device",
    "ch-items": {
      "model": "N9K-C93180YC-FX",
      "ser": "TEST123456"
    },
    "showversion-items": {
      "nxosVersion": "10.6(4)"
    },
    "procsys-items": {
      "bootTime": "1700000000"
    },
    "intf-items": {
      "phys-items": {
        "PhysIf-list": []
      }
    }
  }
}


-- lldpconfig/lldp-settings --
apiVersion: nx.cisco.networking.metal.ironcore.dev/v1alpha1
kind: LLDPConfig
metadata:
  name: lldp-settings
  namespace: default
spec:
  holdTime: 180
  initDelay: 5

-- lldp/config --
apiVersion: networking.metal.ironcore.dev/v1alpha1
kind: LLDP
metadata:
  name: config
  namespace: default
  labels:
    networking.metal.ironcore.dev/device: device
spec:
  deviceRef:
    name: device
  adminState: Up
  providerConfigRef:
    apiVersion: nx.cisco.networking.metal.ironcore.dev/v1alpha1
    kind: LLDPConfig
    name: lldp-settings

-- state/expect --
{
  "System": {
    "name": "device",
    "ch-items": {
      "model": "N9K-C93180YC-FX",
      "ser": "TEST123456"
    },
    "showversion-items": {
      "nxosVersion": "10.6(4)"
    },
    "procsys-items": {
      "bootTime": "1700000000"
    },
    "fm-items": {
      "lldp-items": {
        "adminSt": "enabled"
      }
    },
    "lldp-items": {
      "inst-items": {
        "holdTime": 180,
        "initDelayTime": 5
      }
    }
  }
}
